Kestrel Freight raises a €40 million Series B to expand in North America

Published 4 March 2026

Kestrel Freight today announced a €40 million Series B round. The funding will be used to expand the Chicago office and grow the sales and customer success teams.

"Mid-sized shippers in the US have the same visibility problem we solved in Europe," said CEO Marta Visser. "This round lets us double our go-to-market team in 2026."
